definitions.explanation: A small retail store open long hours, selling food, drinks, and daily necessities. Short for コンビニエンスストア.

examples.japanese: コンビニで{弁当|べんとう}を{買|か}いました。
examples.english: I bought a bento at the convenience store.

examples.japanese: コンビニは24{時間|じかん}{営業|えいぎょう}しています。
コンビニでATMを{使|つか}えます。
examples.english: You can use an ATM at the convenience store.

notes: コンビニ are ubiquitous in Japan and offer many services beyond retail: ATMs, bill payment, ticket purchases, photocopying, and package pickup. Major chains include 7-Eleven, Lawson, and FamilyMart. They are an essential part of daily life in Japan.
